---
become_override: false
ocp_username: opentlc-mgr
silent: false

# Model Registry operator (part of OpenShift AI)
ocp4_workload_model_registry_namespace: rhoai-model-registries
ocp4_workload_model_registry_wait_retries: 40

# Backing MySQL database
ocp4_workload_model_registry_db_name: registry_db
ocp4_workload_model_registry_db_storage: 10Gi

# Name of the ModelRegistry instance. ocp4_workload_model_serving_lab reads
# this as well, to build the registry route for its notebooks; keep the two
# roles in step if you change it.
ocp4_workload_model_registry_instance_name: lab-registry

---
- name: Build the model registry URL for the lab notebooks
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    ocp4_workload_model_serving_lab_registry_url: >-
      https://{{ ocp4_workload_model_registry_instance_name }}-rest.{{ route_subdomain }}

- name: Deploy the notebook workbench
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    definition: "{{ lookup('template', 'workbench.yaml.j2') | from_yaml }}"
